image, Patient Plan Direct White Logo
heading, Affordable dental plans that patients love, level 1

Patient Plan Direct, now part of Agilio Software, helps dental practices build predictable, recurring revenue through practice-branded patient plans. With 700+ practices supported nationwide and over 15 years of expertise, we make it simple to launch, switch, or grow your plan.
heading, Practice-branded dental plans that deliver real value, level 2
Practice-branded dental plans that deliver real value
end of heading, Practice-branded dental plans that deliver real value, level 2

Patient Plan Direct provides dental practices and groups with a practice-branded dental plan solution representing unrivalled value. Whether you’re looking to leave the NHS, switch from another plan provider, or launch a new practice plan, our experienced team will guide you every step of the way.
We are highly responsive and proactive, adopting paperless processes wherever possible. Our people, support, and technology are focused entirely on dental practice plan success.
Our competitively priced plans can significantly boost your practice’s income. No patient registration fees — just one low cost per plan.
heading, Easy management via our online portal, level 3
Simple plan management in a few clicks. Our digital practice portal provides easy-to-use dashboards for patient sign-ups and performance tracking 24/7.
end of heading, Expert support, level 3
We know what it takes to achieve plan success. You’ll be assigned a dedicated Account Manager, plus marketing training and team incentives to drive adoption.
end of heading, Trusted partner, level 3
Our client retention rate is over 99%. With 700+ practices and 15+ years of experience, we’re a proven partner for dental plan success.
end of heading, Global Dental Scheme, level 3
Patients benefit from worldwide dental accident and emergency cover, which gives them added peace of mind and makes your plans more attractive.
Choose your plans and move at your pace. We offer tailored solutions for individual practices and groups alike.
Best for growing or new practices, or NHS conversions and preferable for most situations. They usually include check-ups, x-rays and dental hygiene treatment, with family discounts.
Looking to make a gradual step to private dentistry, or leave NHS dentistry for good? Our expert team can guide you through a successful conversion with proven, tried-and-tested methods.
Considering launching a dental plan for your patients? We’ll help you introduce a simple, flexible, practice-branded solution tailored to your practice and patient base.
